AI prompt & validation record

Project transparency

Build prompt: “Create a responsive HTML digital twin dashboard for a Razer BlackShark V2 Pro headset. Separate imported physical telemetry from simulated scenarios; show battery, connection, microphone and speaker levels, firmware and THX state; support log/JSON/CSV import, JSON/CSV export, history, alerts, scenario testing, and light/dark mode. Do not invent missing telemetry or imply that virtual controls send commands to the physical device.”

Validation checklist: Test theme toggle, each scenario, time-step button, reset, file import with a —, JSON/CSV export, and mobile layout before publishing. This build performs read-only receiver polling in the browser. The battery percentage is not marked live until its response bytes are validated.
